note.after_visit_summary:
You are a new patient here. We reviewed your health records and checked you today. Your thyroid (Hashimoto's) test was a little high, and your cholesterol was also high. Your exam was mostly normal; your thyroid had no swelling and your heart and lungs sound good.

You have been taking your thyroid pill, levothyroxine 88 micrograms once a day, with coffee and calcium. That mixes the dose with things that stop it from working. Please take it alone with water first thing in the morning, 30 to 60 minutes before coffee or food. Take your calcium 600 mg and your vitamin D 2000 units at a different time, such as with dinner.

You do not need a new dose yet. Please stop the hair-skin-nails gummy that may have biotin for 3 days before your blood test. We will recheck your thyroid and cholesterol in 6 to 8 weeks. Eat more fiber, less fatty food, and stay active.

Call us if you feel very unwell, and bring all your pills to the next visit.
